# occupancy of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:occupancyOf`](gmeow-occupancyOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/occupancyOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The location whose occupancy is measured. Functional: an occupancy measurement concerns exactly one location (constitutive of the measurement's identity).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:occupancyOf`](gmeow-occupancyOf.md) from [`gmeow:Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md) to [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), [`gmeow:Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md), [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single location an occupancy measurement concerns; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid several locations per measurement.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:occupancyOf`](gmeow-occupancyOf.md) per [`Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md).
